about.title: About Company
about.subtitle: LLP «Gazservice-7»: sale of quality gas analytical equipment
about.description1: Our company is an official distributor and reliable supplier in the Republic of Kazakhstan of modern gas analytical products manufactured by the Scientific and Production Enterprise «Pharmec» (NPO ODO «PHARMEC», Minsk).
about.description2: Since 2003, from the moment of the company's foundation, we have been successfully working in key industries: oil and gas, mining, energy, and other areas.
about.description3: We are proud of our long-term cooperation with enterprises and organizations such as JSC «QazaqGaz Aimaq», JSC «Mangistaumunaigaz», JSC «KazTransOil», JSC «Almaty Power Stations», JSC «Intergas Central Asia», the group of companies "Eurasian Resources Group» (ERG), LLP «Teplotransit Karaganda», LLP «Almaty Heating Networks», JSC «Ozenmunaigaz», LLP «MAEK – Kazatomprom» and many others.
about.partnersIntro: We are proud to cooperate with leading enterprises of Kazakhstan:
about.activity1: Informing a wide range of consumers about PHARMEC products, their purpose, areas of application, competitive advantages and practice of use at specific facilities.
about.activity2: Supply of portable and stationary gas safety devices, as well as accessories for other measuring instruments
about.advantage1Desc: We are an official dealer of NPO ODO «PHARMEC», Republic of Belarus.
about.advantage2Desc: We will help you select the necessary equipment for various fields of activity.
about.advantage4Desc: Permissive documentation confirming compliance of device parameters with metrological and technical requirements
about.advantage5Desc: We provide logistics support and organize delivery of equipment and materials at times convenient for the client. Our established logistics scheme and partnership relations with manufacturers allow us to ensure minimum delivery times and guarantee product safety.
